name: task-update-edge-dual-read
body: The transitional dual-read in plan_update_task_at widens its records parameter to `&mut Vec<Record>` so an operation-edge rewrite can insert and remove records, and every in-tree caller already holds a Vec. The edge-preferred read/rewrite path carries no direct test assertion — it is exercised indirectly through the add arm's identical edge construction and the preserved fallback e2e — and the derivation assumes at most one per-kind operation edge plus one target destination per task, a malformed record with several picking the last match. Narrow the parameter back to a slice and add a direct edge-path assertion once task-20 retires the legacy fields and phase-5's operation validator enforces the single-edge-set invariant.
